description: Let nested Mara resume following, track contained movement honestly, and give the grue colony an NPC-causal death path.

replacements.new:
(T
           <SET C <LOC ,MARA>>
           <COND (<AND .C <FSET? .C ,VEHBIT> <EQUAL? <META-LOC ,MARA> ,HERE>>
                  <TELL "Mara Tallow steps out of the " D .C " before settling the route between you again." CR>
                  <MOVE ,MARA ,HERE>)>
           <COND (<ZERO? <MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-MET>> <MARA-MEET>)>

<ROUTINE MARA-GRUE-COLONY-DARK? ("AUX" OW OH L?)
    <COND (<NOT <AND <LOC ,MARA> <EQUAL? <META-LOC ,MARA> ,DEAD-END-5>>> <RFALSE>)>
    <SET OW ,WINNER>
    <SET OH ,HERE>
    <SETG WINNER ,MARA>
    <SETG HERE ,DEAD-END-5>
    <SET L? <LIT? ,DEAD-END-5>>
    <SETG WINNER .OW>
    <SETG HERE .OH>
    <COND (.L? <RFALSE>) (T <RTRUE>)>>

<ROUTINE MARA-GRUE-COLONY-DEATH ()
    <COND (<NOT <MARA-GRUE-COLONY-DARK?>> <RFALSE>)>
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,DEAD-END-5>
           <TELL "The last useful light goes out around Mara. Something scrapes inside one fissure, then several others answer. Mara gets as far as, Wait-- before the dark closes from more than one direction. A moment later her field gear strikes the stone. Mara Tallow has been eaten by a grue." CR>)
          (T
           <TELL "Behind you, the light you carried away leaves the mine dead end black. Mara gets as far as, Wait-- before several fissures answer at once. There is a short violent scramble, then the clatter of field gear on stone. Mara Tallow has been eaten by a grue." CR>)>
    <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-MODE ,MARA-MODE-INDEPENDENT>
    <MOVE-ALL ,MARA ,DEAD-END-5>
    <REMOVE ,MARA>
    <RTRUE>>
